opening.argument: The video gives viewers a practical route to Google Ads support for disapproved or delayed ads. The speaker says they will show ways to contact Google Ads for help, then directs viewers to a Contact Us option that opens a form. The demonstrated Help pages show steps for describing and confirming an issue, selecting contact options, and entering a contact name and email for an ad under review. That sequence supports an instructional purpose: it shows where to seek help and what the contact process requires. Phone support is shown as unavailable, but the form remains the demonstrated route. Affiliate links for other resources are disclosed; they are not connected to this Google Ads support process.
